title: ESG & Carbon Emissions Monitoring
thesis: Snowflake consolidates emissions data from 30 facilities — AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT extracts figures from ESG reports, Dynamic Tables compute carbon intensity metrics, and Iceberg export gives BURSA Malaysia and regulators governed access to verified emissions data

talking_points: 2.4 million tonnes CO2e annual emissions across 30 facilities — Scope 1 dominant at 78%.
12% reduction from 2020 baseline — on track for 25% by 2030.
BURSA Malaysia ESG score: B+ — up from B last year.

transition.line: Let's see which facilities drive the most emissions.

talking_points: Top 5 facilities account for 68% of total emissions — led by Pengerang refinery.
Carbon intensity varies 3x between best and worst performing facilities.
Scope 2 computed from 12,000 utility bills — AI_EXTRACT automates data capture.
tabs.call_out: Top 5 facilities = 68% of emissions — carbon intensity varies 3x

transition.line: How are we extracting data from all those reports?

talking_points: One hundred ESG reports parsed by AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT — targets, KPIs, commitments extracted automatically.
Twelve thousand utility bills processed by AI_EXTRACT — no manual data entry.
Cortex Search lets the CSO find any disclosure or commitment across 5 years of reports.
show: Show parsed document example with extracted fields
tabs.call_out: 100 ESG reports + 12K utility bills — AI-extracted, zero manual entry

transition.line: Now let the CSO ask the system directly.

talking_points: Puan Fatimah asks: 'Are we on track for 2030 reduction targets?'
Cortex Analyst computes: 12% reduction achieved, need 25% by 2030 — on track at current trajectory.
Switch to advisor: 'What did our 2023 TCFD disclosure commit to?' — searches 100 reports instantly.
show: Type: 'Are we on track for 2030 targets?'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: emissions analytics + ESG advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake, Iceberg for regulators.

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, seven AWS services.
Iceberg export gives BURSA Malaysia and external auditors governed access.
Malaysia's 2050 net-zero target requires every O&G operator to report transparently.
tabs.call_out: One platform, AI document extraction, open Iceberg for regulators

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for ESG compliance.
